description: Header file defining capabilities, extensions, and related structures for OpenGL and EGL in the ANGLE project, including classes for texture capabilities, extension support, and hardware limitations.
external_methods: void InitMinimumTextureCapsMap(const Version &, const Extensions &, TextureCapsMap *)

classes.name: TextureCaps
classes.description: Represents capabilities of a specific texture format, including support for texturing, filtering, framebuffer attachment, and sample counts.

classes.name: TextureCapsMap
classes.description: Manages a collection of TextureCaps indexed by format or FormatID.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Encapsulates supported OpenGL extension support flags and provides methods to set support based on texture capabilities.

classes.name: Limitations
classes.description: Describes hardware or renderer limitations affecting shader and rendering features.

classes.name: Caps
classes.description: Holds various hardware and implementation-dependent limits and capabilities for OpenGL and EGL.

classes.name: egl::Caps
classes.description: Represents EGL-specific capabilities, including support for NPOT surfaces.

classes.name: egl::DisplayExtensions
classes.description: Contains flags for supported EGL extensions related to display and surface management.

classes.name: egl::DeviceExtensions
classes.description: Contains flags for device-specific EGL extensions.

classes.name: egl::ClientExtensions
classes.description: Contains flags for client-side EGL extensions support.

methods.name: TextureCaps()
methods.description: Constructor for TextureCaps, initializes default support flags.

methods.name: void insert(GLenum internalFormat, const TextureCaps &caps)
methods.description: Inserts a TextureCaps for a specific internal format.

methods.name: const TextureCaps &get(GLenum internalFormat) const
methods.description: Retrieves TextureCaps for a specific internal format.

methods.name: const TextureCaps &get(angle::FormatID formatID) const
methods.description: Retrieves TextureCaps for a specific FormatID.

methods.name: void set(angle::FormatID formatID, const TextureCaps &caps)
methods.description: Sets TextureCaps for a specific FormatID.

methods.name: void setTextureExtensionSupport(const TextureCapsMap &textureCaps)
methods.description: Sets extension support flags based on texture capabilities.

methods.name: bool depthTextureAny() const
methods.description: Checks if any depth texture extension is supported.

methods.name: Extensions()
methods.description: Constructor for Extensions, initializes extension support flags.

methods.name: getStrings()
methods.description: Returns a vector of supported extension strings.

methods.name: DetermineCompressedTextureETCSupport(const TextureCapsMap &textureCaps)
methods.description: Checks if all formats for GL_ANGLE_compressed_texture_etc are supported.

methods.name: GetExtensionInfoMap()
methods.description: Returns a map of extension names to extension info.

methods.name: GenerateMinimumCaps(const Version &clientVersion, const Extensions &extensions)
methods.description: Generates minimal capabilities based on version and extensions.

methods.name: GenerateMinimumTextureCaps(const Version &clientVersion, const Extensions &extensions)
methods.description: Generates minimal texture capabilities based on version and extensions.
